data.name: Ikhlas
data.gender_notes: Ikhlas is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ikhlas means sincerity and purity of intention. It is a quality that is highly valued in Islamic tradition. The name Ikhlas carries the meaning “Sincerity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ikhlas usually hope their child will grow to embody sincerity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: 'And they are the ones who are truthful and sincere to Allah.' (Quran 18:22)
data.etymology: Ikhlas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sincerity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikhlas total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: اخلاص
in_urdu.long_meaning: اخلاص کا مطلب ہے صادق دیانت اور پاک دل. قرآن مجید میں اخلاص کی پہچان اور اس کی اہمیت پر زور دیا گیا ہے. اخلاص ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اسلامی روایات اور عقائد کی روشنی میں بھی اہمیت رکھتا ہے. اس کا مطلب ہے کہ انسان کی زندگی میں خدا کا ڈر، خدا کا خوف، اور خدا کے ساتھ وفا داری کا ہونا، جو اسلام کی بنیادی خصوصیت ہے.

In the Quran, ikhlas is mentioned as a quality that is pleasing to Allah, and it is considered a fundamental aspect of Islamic faith. Ikhlas is about being true to oneself and one's faith, and it is a quality that is highly valued in Islamic tradition. It is associated with the concept of taqwa, or fear of Allah, and it is considered a key component of a person's spiritual growth and development.
